{{Quote|The veermok, of course! Have you seen a more interesting creature? I take every chance I can get to educate others on my findings. Too bad I don't have the time right now!|[[Ronin Lightrunner]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RL">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Ronin Lightrunner|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''veermok''' was a large, ferocious primate native to the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gungan Swamp|swamps]] and woodlands of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Wildlife" />

==Description==
The veermok lived around the fringes of the swamp and woodlands hunting prey, such as [[jimvu]], [[Hrumph/Legends|hrumph]] calves, and [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatch]] cubs, through stealth and surprise. They avoided deep water, as they were weak swimmers. They also had a unique bounding movement that took advantage of powerful upper torso and shoulder rotation, along with strong lengthy arms that dwarfed their skinny hind limbs. A veermok also had powerful, tri-tipped claws for gouging and grabbing.<ref name="Wildlife" />

[[File:VeermokAndJimvu-WSW.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Veermok hunting a [[Jimvu]]]]
The hair on a veermok's back and chest provided protection and insulation. Their hair rose on their back when alarmed or angered. Hairless lower anatomy allowed for easy hygiene.<ref name="Wildlife" />

Veermoks were generally solitary, unless mating. Mates apparently formed a bond during the time in which they were together. If one mate was killed, the remaining mate would take revenge on whatever or whomever was responsible. They were usually semi-territorial, but not always, defending turf from other veermoks. Females mated once a year, building nests on the ground in a bed of leaves and branches. The veermok had a gestation period of three months. They usually gave birth to twins, which in most cases were immediately abandoned by their mother, unlike the more nurturing [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]. It appears that in a few unusual cases a mother would care for her offspring, at least for a short time. Forced to fend for themselves, abandoned twins matured quickly.<ref name="Wildlife" />

Veermoks had an unusual resistance to [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="TSL">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

==History==
Veermok meat was comestible. The cookbook ''[[Essential Cooking Skills]]'' detailed how to best cook that meat.<ref name="SWG:ECS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|ESSENTIAL COOKING SKILLS}}</ref> Veermoks were also popular [[holopet]]s.<ref name="Holopets">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66920&resource=features|text=Holopets}}</ref> The [[leaping veermok]] was an attack of the [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] martial art named after the leaping attack of the veermok.<ref name="SG">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref>
[[File:Veermok-wosfg.jpg|thumb|right|200px|An escaped Veermok on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]]]

During the [[Old Sith Wars]], the [[Systech Corporation/Legends|Systech Corporation]] created a line of [[Systech electric blaster|electrical]] [[Systech static blaster|weapons]] to deal with veermoks by bypassing their resistance to blasters.<ref name="TSL" />

During the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], veermoks were transported to [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask's]] private moon [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]] for [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunting]].<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

In the years prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], a criminal involved in the illegal activities of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Veruna]] on Naboo was nicknamed [[Veermok (Naboo)|Veermok]].<ref name="Monster">{{GamerCite|2|The Monster}}</ref> Around the same time, [[Rann I-Kanu]], [[Galak]], [[Arani Korden]] and [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]] were attacked by a veermok while investigating the presence of a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] based in the jungle near [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="SoNFPG">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=rpg_fastPlay_intro|text=The Smugglers of Naboo|int=The Smugglers of Naboo}}</ref>

Veermoks were at one point imported to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Like many other imported species, such as [[Anooba/Legends|anoobas]] and [[saw-toothed grank]]s, they escaped, roamed the [[Coruscant Underworld|lower levels of Coruscant]], and feasted upon garbage and unfortunate life forms.<ref name="Wildlife" />

Prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Veermok Cave|cave]] that was mined by [[Jandosan Mines]] for its ore in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] on Naboo was overtaken by a pack of giant veermoks, causing all mining activities to be stopped.<ref name="SWG:ac">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|a commoner|Naboo}}</ref> The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ronin Lightrunner]] later visited the cave during his studies about veermoks.<ref name="SWG:RL" />

During the Galactic Civil War, [[Maulers|Mauler]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast masters]] trained veermoks for fighting.<ref name="SWG:MS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|Mauler Stronghold|Naboo}}</ref> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a race of veermoks smaller in size and living near beaches were discovered on Naboo. As scientists were not able to explain the changes in stature and natural habits, a theory that these beasts were [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] and let loose into the wild as emerged. This theory had been rejected by planetary authorities and [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophers]] who simply considered pygmy veermoks as an anomaly.<ref name="Sony" />

Following the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]], the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] brothers [[Heeth Panteer|Heeth]] and [[Raal Panteer]] settled a [[Unidentified moon (Ryloth system)|moon]] in the [[Ryloth system/Legends|Ryloth system]] as a natural reserve. They imported fauna and flora from all around the galaxy to this moon, including veermoks.<ref name="Empire20">[[Empire 20|''Empire'' 20]]</ref>

In the [[New Jedi Order]], [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi initiate]] between the ages of 13 to 14 were part of the [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Jedi training clan]] named [[Veermok Clan]] after the Naboo creature.<ref name="Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>
